name: Balamory
description: Live action series for pre-school children based around the small island community of Balamory in Scotland.

videos.title: Seeking Santa
videos.overview:
Balamory Seeking Santa - Exclusive episode never seen on TV!

It's the day of the nursery Christmas party and Miss Hoolie asks PC Plum to dress up as Santa and bring some Santa wishes for the children. Suzie Sweet promises to 'make the impossible possible' and heads off to the Arctic Circle with Penny. They have a snowy adventure looking for Santa - but how will they be able to bring Santa wishes back to Balamory?

videos.title: Fish Supper
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie is holding a fish supper for the children's grandparents. Spencer makes some decorations to jazz up the nursery. Miss Hoolie asks Spencer to make a fishing game, which he does, with some help from Archie, but Spencer forgets to order the fish and chips for Miss Hoolie. Without fish and chips, there wouldn't be a fish supper. Spencer goes to Pocket and Sweet's, but they don't have enough fish. Penny says to try the fish and chip trailer at the pier. The trailer doesn't have enough fish either. Suzie and Spencer go off quickly and buy some fresh fish from the fishermen, and the fish are cooked at the trailer. Spencer brings the fish to the nursery to eat. They are delicious!

videos.title: The Power Cut
videos.overview: This morning, the electricity goes off and nothing works, not even the TV. Archie decides to invent a TV that doesn't need electricity, but it doesn't have any pictures. So Spencer uses some paintings, then tells a story using socks from his washing basket. It is the Three Billy Goats Gruff, and it is so funny!

videos.title: I Spy
videos.overview: Edie always takes the children to the nursery by bus, but today, they are all feeling bored.

videos.title: Beach Ball
videos.overview: The school children are looking forward to josie telling them all about different ways to travel but since she has only been on the ferry she does not have any. Does anyone else have the answer.

videos.title: The Missing Scarecrow
videos.overview: Sadie notices that the scarecrow is missing from the nursery vegetable patch. It had vanished. Edie asks PC Plum if he could help find the missing scarecrow. PC Plum owned up to breaking the missing scarecrow. He'd mistaken it for a burglar. Edie takes the broken scarecrow to Archie. If anyone could fix it, Archie could. And he does, too, with a little help from all the children.

videos.title: Storm in a Nursery
videos.overview: Edie arrives at the nursery looking for a lifejacket and sounding worried about her sailing trip with PC Plum. Miss Hoolie tries to make Edie feel better by saying how Miss Hoolie loves sailing. It works. Edie goes home all excited and daring to go on PC Plum's boat. Unfortunately, a storm means they have to cancel the boat trip. Edie is fed up and PC Plum sends her along to see Josie, who takes Edie on a pretend sea trip. The children and Miss Hoolie go, too. It is a great, fun day on the ocean waves for Edie after all.

videos.title: Walking the Dog
videos.overview: Today, Josie Jump is looking after a dog named Ralph. She goes to see Edie McCredie for advice on how to keep the dog amused, but Edie thinks Ralph is a boy. P.C. Plum gives Josie some tips on looking after the dog, and they take it for a walk in the park with some of the nursery children.

videos.title: Art Gallery
videos.overview: The children paint pictures to help cure Penny's hiccups.

videos.title: Seals
videos.overview: Spencer comes this morning with a bag of coloured paper that he doesn't know what to do with. Miss Hoolie tells him to visit Archie, who has ideas of making party hats and a kite tail. In the end, Archie and Spencer make a book. Suzie thinks the book would make a perfect photo album for the children at the nursery, one they could keep to remind them of their seal trip. Penny gives Spencer some cameras. Spencer and the children dash down to the harbour to catch a boat. What a wonderful day they had. And what a wonderful photo album they made.

videos.title: Hair Cut
videos.overview: PC Plum is having trouble keeping his long floppy fringe out of his eyes. He tries out a visor, but his helmet keeps falling off while he's on his bike. Edie suggests some rather undignified solutions, like curlers and a shower cap. P.C. Plum refuses these suggestions, and goes to Archie for advice. Archie realises that P.C. Plum is making excuses, and says that the only solution is to get his hair cut.

videos.title: Jungle Story
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie hopes to take the children into the garden, but it is raining. Josie pops in. Miss Hoolie asks her to tell the children a story about animals. She doesn't know much about animals, so she asks PC Plum. Josie has fun pretending to be a beetle, a sheepdog and a pigeon. PC Plum keeps getting phone calls, so Josie visits Edie McCredie. Edie tells Josie about the jungles of Africa, so Josie comes back and tells the children a fantastic jungle story.

videos.title: Feeding the Lambs
videos.overview: P.C. Plum arrives at the nursery feeling very sleepy, because he has been up most of the night helping the local farmer feed his lambs. P.C. Plum thinks that the children would like to see the lambs, but if he is going to go with them, he will have to be woken up. Edie takes P.C. Plum to see Josie Jump, to see if she can help.

videos.title: The Sandcastle
videos.overview: Spencer wants to build a sandcastle, but has no bucket and spade, what can he use instead?

videos.title: Odd Socks
videos.overview: Archie's wearing odd socks, and he can't find the other one. He visits his sister and niece. He helps his young niece, Megan, pair her socks.

videos.title: Mending a Puncture
videos.overview: PC Plum is really looking forward to umpiring the cricket match, but he has a flat tyre. Who can help him?

videos.title: Newborn Baby
videos.overview: Spencer calls in to tell Miss Hoolie that Tommy Mackenzie's mother has a newborn baby girl. Spencer goes to buy a present from Pocket and Sweet's. He gets caught playing with things on the shelves and ends up buying everything but a present for the new baby. Archie has a great idea. With the children, he makes a beautiful mobile from old coat hangers, string and painted paper plates. Spencer hangs the mobile over Tommy's new baby sister's cot. She seems to love her first present.

videos.title: The Lost Voice
videos.overview: Poor PC Plum has a sore throat. Miss Hoolie makes him some honey and lemon tea. Edie's bus is causing a traffic jam, so PC Plum asks her to move it. Because he'd lost his voice, Edie thinks it is a game. PC Plum tries to write things down but is running out of paper. Josie Jump shows him another way to say what he means. PC Plum gets the hang of it, but then Edie moves her bus anyway. So Josie and PC Plum play charades with the children instead.

videos.title: Camping
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie and PC Plum are planning to take her friends children on a trip.

videos.title: Road Signs
videos.overview: Edie McCredie arrives at the Balamory Nursery complaining about the appearance of strange road signs which have popped up all over Balamory- they have clown faces on them. The clowns have been put there by Archie, but he likes them so much he is oblivious to Edie's pleas for him to take them down. She passes the buck to P.C. Plum. As it happens, P.C. Plum is captivated by the clowns, and helps Archie find a place to display them where they won't cause problems.

videos.title: Golf
videos.overview: After Josie Jump teaches Spencer how to play golf, Miss Hoolie, the children and Spencer make a crazy golf course in the cafe.

videos.title: The Sandboat
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks PC Plum to take the children to the beach to collect shells. PC Plum can't make sense of the tidal timetable so Archie suggests they use a sandboat to show when the tide is coming in.

videos.title: The Ferry Boat
videos.overview: It's a play day in Balamory. Archie is looking after a boy called Liam, but Liam is unhappy because he was supposed to spend the day with his cousin Stevie. Stevie has been called way to drive the Balamory ferry. Archie asks Edie for ideas of places to take Liam on a day trip, but she thinks the only solution is to take him on the ferry, so he can see Stevie.

videos.title: Ceilidh
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie thinks she could have a ceilidh. Suzie says she'd organize it all by herself. She gets Penny to do the refreshments and Spencer to fix the band. Then Suzie becomes very tired from dancing. She needs help, so Josie leads the dancing. Later on, Suzie recovers enough to teach the children the Balamory Two-Step.

videos.title: Suzie's Muddle
videos.overview: Suzie Sweet delivers the wrong things, after Penny moves things on the shop shelves.

videos.title: Milking Cows
videos.overview: Archie wants to show the nursery children his latest invention- a milk dispenser. Miss Hoolie says that he should show them where milk comes from in the first place. He knows that Milk comes from cows, so he borrows a model of a cow from Edie McCredie. But he still doesn't know exactly how cows are milked, so he needs to see P.C. Plum.

videos.title: Birthday Party
videos.overview: Today PC Plum is trying to organise a birthday party for Callum, his nephew. Callum is unusual because he never plays with toys- he likes to sit in boxes and pretend they are boats, planes etc. P.C. Plum and Archie make a cardboard rocket as a present for Callum.

videos.title: Musical Hamper
videos.overview: Penny is organizing a picnic lunch. But she needs the hamper to put everything in. She goes to Archie's castle to fetch it. Archie had made it into a musical hamper. It plays a different tune every time you open the lid. When Penny brings it back, there is no sign of the picnic lunch. She calls in PC Plum to find out where it had gone. Suzie solves the mystery. She remembers that she'd sold PC Plum the food for the picnic. PC Plum returns everything, and the children go on a picnic. They eat, drink and play musical statues to the sound of Archie's amazing musical hamper.

videos.title: Painting Plates
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks Penny if there's anything in the shop that she could send to her friend in London from Balamory. There is nothing in Pocket and Sweet's shop, but Spencer comes up with the perfect solution.

videos.title: Swimming With Spencer
videos.overview: Spencer has been invited to go swimming, the only problem is he can't swim. Who can help?

videos.title: Snake
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks Edie to tell the children a story about an exotic animal from her travels, so she tells a story about a snake.

videos.title: Cleaning Teeth
videos.overview: Spencer comes up with a fantastic routine to make teeth sparkle.

videos.title: The Line Dance
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks Josie to teach the children how to line dance. The only problem is who can teach Josie?!

videos.title: Kite
videos.overview: It's a windy day in Balamory & PC Plum wants to go kite flying. The only problem is that the shop has sold out of kites. What will PC Plum do next?

videos.title: Teddy Bears Picnic
videos.overview: Oh, dear! Spencer has lost Philip his teddybear. Will he find him in time for the teddybears picnic?

videos.title: Guinea Pig
videos.overview: Archie is looking after a guinea pig called George. He goes to the shop to buy food for him, but when he returns, George is missing, so he needs to call P.C. Plum.

videos.title: Sound Sculpture
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie performs her nursery song for children in the nursery. Josie finds a key. Who does it belong to?

videos.title: Sports Day
videos.overview: Josie is ill and has asked PC Plum to organise the games for the nursery sports day.

videos.title: Sponge Painting
videos.overview: Spencer wants to do some painting in the garden with the children, but it's too cold. Who can help the children keep warm.

videos.title: Dressing Up Day
videos.overview: It's dressing up day in Balamory. Miss Hoolie and the children are really looking forward to it. But will PC Plum dress up as a policeman again?

videos.title: The lifeboat
videos.overview: Spencer is painting a picture for the lifeboat station, but hasn't enough time to finish it. The children help him; but the painting is too big to go on Spencer's cart!

videos.title: Football
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks Edie McCredie to hold a football match, but she doesn't know how the rules work.

videos.title: The Visit to the Doctor
videos.overview: Today Josie buys a gift for Peter, she also gets a sore foot.

videos.title: Dances From Ribbons
videos.overview: Nursery children are to a dance at garden tea party but Edie has used costumes to clean engine, children dance with ribbons.

videos.title: Go Cart
videos.overview: Suzie learns to drive a car and plays a driving game with the children.

videos.title: Thunder
videos.overview: Penny is afraid of thunder, so she looks to PC Plum and Archie to try to overcome her fear.

videos.title: Looking After Baby
videos.overview: Josie has trouble looking after a baby after she accidentally wakes it up.

videos.title: The Tortoise and the Hare
videos.overview: Suzie is supposed to read the children a story, but she is having a very busy day. She asks Penny to collect a story book from Archie's castle. When Penny arrives at the nursery, Suzie isn't there, so Penny asks PC Plum to help find Suzie. PC Plum spots a trail of jelly beans, which lead to Suzie, who is fast asleep in the nursery garden. Suzie then tells the children a story about a slow tortoise and a speedy hare.

videos.title: Sound Story
videos.overview: Edie thinks the children might like to listen to a story tape while they're in her bus. Miss Hoolie lends her a story book she found, and Edie goes to see Josie Jump to use her tape recorder. Josie helps with the story and does lots of funny actions. When Edie listens to the tape, it doesn't seem as good without the actions. She goes to ask Spencer to add some music, but he does more than that - he adds creaks and boings and many other sounds. It sounds great. Edie comes back to the cafe, and Miss Hoolie helps to make the story tape.

videos.title: Aeroplane
videos.overview: Suzie wants to tell the children a story about flying, but she's never flown.

videos.title: Dirty Bus
videos.overview: Josie teaches everyone her cleaning song, but they soon run out of things to clean. Can Edie McCreadie help?

videos.title: One Man Band
videos.overview: Today Spencer is off to the mainland to take part in a music festival.

videos.title: Regatta
videos.overview: It's Regatta day but all the boats look the same. But Spencer has an idea.

videos.title: Pony Ride
videos.overview: It's all happening today - spilt paint, missing carrots and a homemade carrot picking machine! What on earth is going on?

videos.title: Two by Two
videos.overview: Josie wants to teach the children some animal movements today but she needs some help. Never fear, Edie is at the ready.

videos.title: Obstacle Course
videos.overview: Today Suzie wants to get rid of some empty boxes from the shop but doesn't know what to do with them. Josie has an idea.

videos.title: Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks PC Plum to organise a treasure hunt. But he'll need a map & some treasure. Who can help?

videos.title: Garden Competition
videos.overview: Spencer makes bunting for a garden competition.

videos.title: Underwater World
videos.overview: Edie is taking the children to Underwater World but the bus won't start. Can Spencer help? Spencer decorates the bus to make it look like Underwater World. Then - the bus is fixed - but it's time to go home.

videos.title: Pipe Tree
videos.overview: Today Miss Hoolie finds a pile of old pipes in the cupboard. She has no ides what to do with them. Luckily PC Plum & Archie get inspired.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Today: Halloween party at the nursery.

videos.title: Getting Up
videos.overview: Today we learn Edie isn't very good at getting up in the morning.

videos.title: Noisy Hat
videos.overview: Today in Balmory Archie has made a new invention. It's called a noisy hat, and it makes farm animal noises. Archie and Spencer prepare a farmyard song to sing with the nursery children.

videos.title: Basketball
videos.overview: Today Edie is supposed to referee a basketball match, but she doesn't know anything about basketball. Josie tries to teach her the rules, but she finds them too complicated. As it turns out, Penny Pocket plays basketball, and agrees to referee the game in her place.

videos.title: Pantomime
videos.overview: A pantomime for the children in Balamory Hall. Miss Hoolie takes the role of Cinderella, with Edie as Prince Charming. Archie and PC Plum put in star turns as the Ugly Sisters, Spencer is Buttons, and Josie is Dandini. Finally, Suzie and Penny put in an appearance as the two Fairy Godmothers.

videos.title: PLEASE DELETE
videos.overview: PLEASE DELETE

videos.title: The Lost Letter
videos.overview: Spencer finds out Miss Hoolie didn't get the invitation to a surprise party for herself.

videos.title: Family Meal
videos.overview: Archie has been invited over for a family meal at Amber's house, but the trouble is that he has inventor's block. What will he do?

videos.title: Hobby Horse
videos.overview: Archie presents Miss Hoolie with a pen tree made from coathangers to keep her pens tidy.

videos.title: Windy Day
videos.overview: PC Plum's hat blows away, and he tries to find alternatives.

videos.title: Living Statue
videos.overview: Penny Pocket visits the nursery to tell Miss Hoolie that Suzie Sweet has decided to encourage people to recycle. But soon, she and Edie McCredie see a mysterious burglar in the shop. What are they going to do?

videos.title: Fun Run
videos.overview: There is a Fun Run happening in Balamory today, and Josie Jump can't take part unless she finds somebody else to start the race. But who can help Josie out?

videos.title: Car Boot Sale
videos.overview: PC Plum's office is cluttered with stuff he wants to throw away but Miss Hoolie tells him to take them to a car boot sale and use them as items for anyone to buy them.

videos.title: Chinese Festival
videos.overview: The residents of the island celebrate Chinese New Year, complete with a lion dance.

videos.title: The Waiter
videos.overview: Suzie is nervous about helping out at her cousin's café on the mainland. It seems there is so much to do! How will she remember what everyone has ordered?

videos.title: Bun Fest
videos.overview: Archie isn't interested in helping out at the Balamory Bun Festival, but he definitely wants to sample some of the buns.

videos.title: Noises in the Night
videos.overview: Edie helps a friend fit a new toilet in the bathroom of her friend's house. The problem is that she only knows a little about toilets.

videos.title: The Plumber
videos.overview: Edie helps a friend fit a new toilet in the bathroom of her friend's house. The problem is that she only knows a little about toilets.

videos.title: Litter Bug
videos.overview: There's a litter bug in Balamory.  PC Plum and friends set out to find the culprit.

videos.title: Musical Houses
videos.overview: Suzie Sweet has been eating her dinner in the shop and doing her ironing in the café. How can Penny Pocket get her to do things in the right place?

videos.title: Snow
videos.overview: It is snowing, and PC Plum is worried about one of his friends who doesn't get out much. He wants to find a way to bring the winter magic to her house.

videos.title: Shops
videos.overview: Josie Jump wants to play shops with the children at the nursery, but who can help her make it fun?

videos.title: Daffodil Tea Party
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie organises a daffodil tea party for the children's parents at the nursery.

videos.title: The Sing Along Machine
videos.overview: PC Plum tries to solve the mystery of the strange voice in the night which is keeping everyone awake.

videos.title: Bubbles
videos.overview: Josie teaches the children to play with bubbles.

videos.title: Steam Train
videos.overview: PC Plum has promised to take Miss Hoolie out for the day, but he has double-booked himself, as he has also promised to go on a fishing trip with Spencer on the same day.

videos.title: Bassoon
videos.overview: The nursery children are eagerly awaiting a visit from a bassoon player. Archie decides to come along too, and he invents a musical instrument to play along with her.

videos.title: Kitten
videos.overview: Edie is very sad because her friend's cat has died. Spencer and PC Plum find ways to cheer her up.

videos.title: Jennifer
videos.overview: The children want to play in the garden, but there is no rabbit run for Jennifer the rabbit. Edie sets out to find the materials to make one.

videos.title: Playground
videos.overview: Suzie and Penny have bought some new games for the shop, but they don't know how to play them.

videos.title: Gardening
videos.overview: It's a sunny day, so the children help in Mrs. Reilly's garden.

videos.title: Disco
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie asks PC Plum to organise a disco for the children, but he doesn't know much about music.

videos.title: Busy Cafe
videos.overview: Suzie rushes back and forth and gets very tired.

videos.title: Back to Front
videos.overview: Penny's wheelchair needs mending, so Edie pumps the wheel up for her before the activity lesson at the Nursery.

videos.title: Washing
videos.overview: Everyone is upset at Spencer for messing things up, to which he finds out that he has forgotten to wash his hands and is covering everything he touches in green paint.

videos.title: The Sizeometer
videos.overview: Archie's new invention doesn't seem to impress anyone.

videos.title: Sneeze
videos.overview: Archie has a problem where cannot stop sneezing.

videos.title: The Story Blanket
videos.overview: Josie wants to tell a story for the nursery children as they cannot go outside due to the rain, but just ends up making a big mess instead.

videos.title: Pancake Party
videos.overview: It's pancake day in the nursery and PC Plum keeps losing his eggs.

videos.title: Exercise
videos.overview: Josie Jump's jumping classes aren't as popular as they used to be and wants to find a sort of gimmick, gizmo or gadget to get more people involved. Who in Balamory will help her?

videos.title: Doll's Hospital
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie has been asked to look after Caitlin's doll, but Edie accidentally sits on the doll and breaks it. What can she do?

videos.title: Nursery Safari
videos.overview: Edie McCredie wants to go on safari in Balamory, but it sounds too much of a challenge. Can PC Plum manage this?

videos.title: Symbols and Signs
videos.overview: Archie wants to take the nursery children on a tour of the island to see how many street signs they can spot, but it's too far for them to walk.

videos.title: The Hat Story
videos.overview: Penny uses the hats in Edie's lost and found box to tell the children a story about different people who might wear them.

videos.title: Grandmother's Footsteps
videos.overview: PC Plum loves to watch animals, but he keeps scaring them away. Spencer has offered to help him, but how?

videos.title: Sheepdog
videos.overview: PC Plum wants to bring in Sandy the sheepdog in to show the children, but she is too busy with work on the farm. What can PC Plum do?

videos.title: Leaves
videos.overview: Spencer helps out a neighbour to rake leaves, but he doesn't know what to do with them all.

videos.title: Animal Hospital
videos.overview: When Edie finds a hedgehog, she tries to find a way to look after it but has trouble doing so.

videos.title: Fun Fair
videos.overview: Archie needs to go to the funfair to collect sugar for the candy floss stall, but he is scared of the rides there.

videos.title: Likes and Don't Likes
videos.overview: Edie tries to buy a Spice Girls CD from Suzie and Penny's, but they're all sold out. When she doesn't get anything else she's looking for, Josie helps her help Suzie and Penny find out what everyone else likes and doesn't like.

videos.title: Magic
videos.overview: Josie wants to tell the children a story about a magician, but she needs a magic box and a magic trick. What will she do?

videos.title: Buddies
videos.overview: Spencer wants to take the nursery children to visit their buddies at the primary school, but who will tell him where to go?

videos.title: The Memory Tree
videos.overview: Edie has a box of keepsakes from her woodland walks but doesn't know what to do with them.

videos.title: Face Painting
videos.overview: At the Balamory bazaar, Edie is supposed to run the face painting stall, but she doesn't know how to do it.

videos.title: Ways to Travel
videos.overview: Josie promises to tell the children stories about exciting ways to travel – but she has only ever been on the ferry.

videos.title: Gymnastics
videos.overview: Suzie has a new hobby – juggling and stilt walking, and is causing trouble in the shop. Who can stop the chaos?

videos.title: Big City
videos.overview: Archie wants to take his nephew Christopher to the Science Centre in the Big City but is unsure what it's like to him.

videos.title: Doctors and Nurses
videos.overview: Archie makes an x-ray machine for the children to use when they are playing doctors & nurses.

videos.title: The Story Pole
videos.overview: Spencer wants to tell the children the story of Princess Sally, but he can't remember how the story goes.

videos.title: Tasty
videos.overview: The children bake some biscuits for PC Plum's tasting session.

videos.title: Cycling Story
videos.overview: Josie Jump and Miss Hoolie are on a bicycle ride today, but Josie doesn't know the rules of the road. Luckily, there's someone in Balamory who can help her.

videos.title: Ice Skating
videos.overview: Josie is going to the mainland to go ice-skating and wants to borrow a CD to listen to while skating.

videos.title: Indian Wedding
videos.overview: Balamory is in celebration mode as Penny and Suzie help organise an Indian wedding, but Suzie gets the arrangements muddled up! Will things be fixed in time?

videos.title: Pirate Party
videos.overview: Today is Miss Hoolie's birthday and PC Plum and Spencer organise a surprise party for her.

videos.title: Air Guitar
videos.overview: Spencer wants to play his guitar for the nursery children.

videos.title: Paddle Steamer
videos.overview: The paddle steamer runs out of tickets. Edie comes to the rescue by using old raffle tickets.

videos.title: Jungle
videos.overview: PC Plum helps Spencer find his guitar.

videos.title: Sailing
videos.overview: PC Plum is in a muddle, and will he be able to complete his jobs in time before he goes out sailing with Miss Hoolie?

videos.title: The Snowflake Fairy
videos.overview: It's time for the winter, but Archie is feeling a bit glum after being ill with flu. Who will wipe away his frowns and bring back his smiles in time for the party?

videos.title: Oh Dear
videos.overview: Edie wants to go deer spotting with PC Plum, but when she finds out Archie has her tent and his nephews are enjoying using it, Archie suggests another way – by dressing up as a pantomime horse. This new plan however causes trouble around Balamory.

videos.title: Plonk Blocks
videos.overview: Josie Jump searches for special building blocks to help her tell a fairground story.

videos.title: Postcards
videos.overview: Penny gets distracted by watching a football match, and forgets to make an important order for the shop.

videos.title: Suzie's Flying Lesson
videos.overview: Suzie takes a flying lesson, but needs someone to go with her so they can tell the children what the island looks like from the air.

videos.title: Beach Bonanza
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie faces a dilemma when she makes too many promises of taking people to the beach.

videos.title: Sausages
videos.overview: Edie has so much to do, and is so caught up on rushing tasks in order to prepare for a visit to the farm with the children that she forgets to close her bus door and the sausages she bought are taken. Who has stolen them?

videos.title: Gospel Choir
videos.overview: PC Plum organises a gospel choir performance at the nursery. But he spends so much time practicing his singing that he neglects his police work – leaving Penny to solve a mystery involving missing flowers.

videos.title: Ballet
videos.overview: Josie asks Miss Hoolie to help think of a ballet the children might enjoy watching her class perform.

videos.title: Tantrums
videos.overview: Archie keeps getting angry when things aren't going the way he wants. However, there is someone in Balamory to help him calm down.

videos.title: Spaghetti Day
videos.overview: It is PC Plum's Birthday, and he promises to take Miss Hoolie to an Italian restaurant to celebrate. However, after getting caught up on work, they both miss the ferry. What can they do?

videos.title: Buggies and Prams
videos.overview: Josie is meant to be taking the mums and toddlers with their buggies and prams to the soft play centre in the big city, but is worried that she'll get lost.

videos.title: Couch Potato
videos.overview: Edie is tired out, she is having to do favours for Archie. When they both get wiped, who will help them get back on their feet again?

videos.title: Horsepower
videos.overview: Miss Hoolie and her visitors are meant to tour Balamory on Edie's bus, but it develops a problem that even Archie can't fix.

videos.title: Broken Down Bus
videos.overview: PC Plum is really looking forward to umpiring the cricket match, but he has a flat tyre. Who can help him?

videos.title: Five a Side
videos.overview: Suzie organises a five-a-side football match, but she doesn't know how to play football.

videos.title: The Street Party
